    return NBEATSModel(input_chunk_length=168, output_chunk_length=168, n_epochs=ep,
        batch_size=1024, random_state=42, likelihood=QuantileRegression(C.QUANTILE_LEVELS),
        pl_trainer_kwargs={"accelerator":acc,"enable_progress_bar":False,
        "enable_model_summary":False,"logger":False})
for acc in ["mps","cpu"]:
    m = mk(acc,3); t=time.time(); m.fit(tr, val_series=va); dt=time.time()-t
    print(f"nbeats {acc} bs1024 smallval: 3ep={dt:.1f}s -> {dt/3:.1f}s/ep")
EOF
